author_basis.principle: Company-wide after-tax cashflows before debt payments are distinct from reported CFO.
Normalize/review profit, reinvestment, tax and financing consistently; neither a single current CF nor recovery growth supplies steady assumptions.
Terminal FCFF is n+1 following the final explicit forecast n, not an automatically annualized interim result.
